_comment: Chat abbreviations and short English words kept exactly as typed inside Arabizi messages (ADR 0035): the engine swaps them for placeholders before the model or the rules run, so `idk`, `tbh` or `mins` never become Arabic letters. Matched as whole words, case-insensitive, without the punctuation around them. Most never appear in the training data, so the model guesses at them. Left out because they are Arabizi too: ya, min, ye, y, fyi (فيي), hb, bruh, dm (دم), fam, def, ez, eta, 2b, and single letters (u, r, k, n). eval/tests/test_chat_abbreviations.py checks that no word here is mostly converted to Arabic in the training data. Hand-made list (Recommendation, 8 Nov 2026), not generated.
